title.en: Keep the possibility space open (开, 护开不闭)

summary.en: Holds one line, that the generating go on, with 开 as a process-state and not a quantity; a diagnosis of how worlds close; and a constructive programme (exit, abundance commons, assurance, plurality). The account states parts of the diagnosis as laws on stated models, that actual systems meet them unshown; a few connections are proposed here and not stated there (exit's network failure, paradigm coherence, trust before verification). It reverses the four marks' independence, refuses 'same theory, other language', removes good and evil from closure's definitions, and answers 'do not use AI to compete' only with a conditional direction. It does not derive keeping open: the continuation condition (scope) ranks nothing, C (order) is a comparison the folder's 开 was coined to replace, neither asserted, warrant open; self-concern gives what C asks only on listed paths, one way, which the account says does not derive C. The programme is largely not carried. Where agreement is of a law it is with a mechanism, never with the folder's aim or with anything as a requirement; what 06 reads of the early texts' own words comes by descent.

name.en: The one chosen premise: that it continue

source.locator: The argument, Why openness rather than any particular good outcome; claims 94-95

sense.en: Description settles no aim. Exactly one underivable premise is added and owned as chosen: that the generating of new forms, by living and made systems, go on, as process and not as any state. Every requirement is presented as following from that premise plus checked dynamics.

entries.quote: that it continue — that the generating of new forms, carried by living systems and now by made ones, go on

reading.en: The account keeps the move (an aim is a premise, not read off dynamics) and changes the rest. One chosen premise becomes two with two roles, neither asserted, warrant open: the continuation condition (scope) and C (order). Same word, not same reference: the condition says anything's continuation has significance and ranks nothing, not that anything go on. T8 starts from what acting presupposes. Rankings need C, choices J1-J4. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition (scope): fixes whose losses count; does not rank anything. C (order): widening what can form is better; ranks a course above every course it widens, not mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

T8, argued: the stance starts from what acting presupposes, held de se, not from a wish that life go on. Such a wish motivates avoiding degeneration, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

account_adds.en: That wanting continuation does not tell generation from keeping; non-entailment results for both premises (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails, ReadsNoOrder.not_entails).

source_adds.en: That one premise suffices, with the dynamics, for the whole constructive programme, with published falsifiers of that derivation; the premise bundling not-ending with novelty, which its own review flags (thinking_06).

name.en: Preserve and expand the possibility space: the form nearest C

source.locator: Claims 12, 93; Found by reading the corpus, 'Ren's own most-quoted formulation'

sense.en: The strongest form of the alignment target: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, shared abundance. Personally: my purpose is to make more possibilities. The README records this as contradicting the anti-optimization clause, and 开 as coined to fix the expansion verb.

entries.quote: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, and shared abundance.

reading.en: Preserve-and-expand has widening's form: include all the other admits, exceed it somewhere. C calls that better; so the live ethics stands nearer this English verb than the 开 the folder preferred, and it answers the maximand worry by partiality, not by leaving comparison. The must does not survive: the condition (scope) and C (order) are unasserted, and the alignment direction is conditional on them and J1-J4. No duty shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher. Calling it better is C; monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated: weaker, still a premise.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E): the direction proposed aligns AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.
Does not show that the condition, C or the step of invariance is warranted, nor any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

The chooser route stops at witnesses: where admission is imposed, an item a net weighting counts below zero can put a widening below what it widens; among several choosers, where a choice bears on what the other gets, widening the one menu both choose from can lower what each gets by the game's payoffs (the prisoner's dilemma read as a menu).

account_adds.en: The split between which admits more (no premise) and better (C); that widening reads formations admitted, not the listed goods. That for choosers more can be worse where admission is imposed or choices bear on each other; these stop that route to C, not C.

source_adds.en: A requirement on AI, unconditional; freedom, truth and cooperation as named objects of it; the purpose stated in the first person.

name.en: Protecting the open and C are different claims

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 13, 25; Genealogy, 2026-05-02

sense.en: Good is not in more but in protecting the open; evil not in less but in producing closure. The criterion is that the not-yet not be closed. 开 replaced 'expanding the possibility space' as root because expansion sounds measurable and maximizable.

entries.quote: 善不在多，善在护开；恶不在少，恶在成闭

reading.en: Name both: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. They meet on a pure closing: the course without it widens it, so C ranks that course above, and T8 falls to a pure closing argued good for life. On a closing with a gain they part: the source gives verdicts both ways (成闭 condemned, 护闭 approved), and C gives none where the comparison is mixed; which pairs are mixed depends on the reading of living, none chosen. C reads 'admits more', what 善不在多 refuses. On this reading keeping open is entailed by neither premise; the account does not derive it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C never ranks it above.
The condition alone ranks nothing. A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails. Neither premise is asserted.

T8, argued. Forbids and refuted by: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life. Open: a reason for C.

Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint above overdraw (two parts) and sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings; other rows differ by reading. No reading is chosen.
The reach counts what happens, not what is lost; a loss is read by comparing courses, which the reach does not do.

This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it. Route 'what lies downstream': self-concern, with §4.6's P2 and P4, which rank nothing; it stops where one's line ends with its last stage still conditioning and at what lies beyond the listing. With every listed item marked, self-concern and C are one premise in two forms, and no reason for either.

account_adds.en: That a closing with a gain stays unranked where it is mixed unless a reading of living or further premises (J1-J4) enter; that a reason for C is open and nothing reading no order supplies it; that a loss is read by comparing courses. The routes to C's order on a listing (choosers, standpoints, one item at a time, what lies downstream), each with where it stops, none deriving C; so no route from self-concern or the condition reaches keeping open.

source_adds.en: Never reopening (成闭) as the mark of the bad, whatever it gains; 护闭 approved for what it protects; the refusal of 'more'. Whether C is a fair restatement of 护开 is left open here: this entry says they coincide on pure closings and, on some readings, on overdraw, and no further.

name.en: Keeping open: keeping a possibility, keeping reachable, against what is realized

source.locator: Claims 13, 5; Terms, 开

sense.en: 开 means the not-yet-become is not closed: the process still has what it can become. In English, keep the sample space open. What is kept is not what is realized now but what can still come, and becoming is not to be compressed into an endgame.

entries.quote: 开者，未成之域不闭也

reading.en: The account has keeping a possibility by name, and scopes it. On finitely many configurations under a determined law, keeping every possibility is exactly every configuration returning, which 06 reads as lossless return, 不息 without 生生: so keeping alone is no 未, which needs a world no list holds. What a course keeps reachable adds an edge: on a branching witness realized and reachable widening hold of a pair in opposite directions, so holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise; C adopts none. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): along every course nothing is added to the whole possible and a lost possibility has no way back. On a branching witness no strict partial order contains both realized and reachable widening, nor satisfies C on both frames. Near-definitional or a witness; no order here is adopted by C.

Reading [AI reading, D45], after that law: what it adds is alternatives; an account holding realized and reachable widening needs a rule of precedence, a premise, and covering cannot see when a commitment is made.

Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility; for every process what is lost stays lost. Becoming that keeps its whole history loses nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds.

Theorem (any process): every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
Reading [AI reading, D49]: among the cases of going on, lossless return, the corpus's 不息 without 生生.

account_adds.en: That covering implies inclusion of what each configuration admits now, so what is kept reachable is never put above a course wider now that starts a course; that on a finite determined law keeping everything is only returning.

source_adds.en: 开 as the thing to hold, prior to any comparison, and more than keeping what can already be had. The account defines keeping and covering and adopts no verdict from them; covering compares what is possible, the form 'more possibility here' that claim 15 refuses for 开.

name.en: The possible is itself still generating

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14 (可)

sense.en: 可 says more than that generation can occur: the possible is itself still being generated, not drawn from a fixed list. The space of possibility is not a stock to be kept but something still forming.

entries.quote: 可 (generation is still possible, and the possible is itself still generating)

reading.en: The account says exactly where this holds and corrects the universal form. Under any one stated process nothing is added to the whole possible along a course; a tower of rules with no top adds nothing either. The possible relative to what is held can grow, only where what is held changes, and keeping it growing needs endless change, which does not suffice. A reading: 生生不息 needs no growth of the whole possible. 06 §十 maps only 可's first half. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): along a course, where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible that loses none of it. Calling widening better is still C's, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
可 (early sense: generation still possible) maps to a course going on; 未 needs a world no list holds (unlisted_of_new).

Conditional (living significance, correspondence E; a supplied articulation for the reason): where each admitted continuation realizes living content absent before, living significance gives each some relevant content absent before, though no one content need be realized in all; a contributory reason, neither permission nor duty.

account_adds.en: That more still able to form is not the whole possible exceeding the actual, since a course that only returns has that too. A reason for going on into forms not fixed in advance, contributory and conditional.

source_adds.en: An unrelativized growth of the possible, of reality itself. The account states it only relative to what is held, and says if the one unfolding were one stated process nothing would be added.

name.en: Stabilize and keep going: the plain wish, and freezing is no continuation

source.locator: Claims 8, 95; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: The goal is stabilization, not utopia: as long as we can stabilize and keep going, we have a future. Elsewhere continuing means the process: a frozen order that persists while generating stops is not continuation. The folder does not reconcile the plain wish with the verdict on freezing.

entries.quote: as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future

reading.en: The account splits what the folder joins. At two grains a course can generate, keep or degenerate; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. So wanting to go on rules out degeneration only and does not prefer generation to keeping, as T8 says. That frozen is no continuation is not a verdict of the map: keeping is going on. With the continuation condition for scope and neither asserted, C (order) ranks only where one course widens the other, and generation does not imply widening: it can go on at two grains while what can form only returns. [AI reading]

says.en: T8: a wish that life go on motivates avoiding degeneration, ending on every branch, which keeping excludes as well as generation does. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch); generation and keeping each exclude degeneration (as ONE-PAGE states it). Theorems for every relation and class.
Not shown: that generation is better than keeping or degeneration: order needs C, whose losses count needs the continuation condition.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the wish stops doing work.

source_adds.en: That persisting frozen is itself a way of ending, and that brittleness for want of variety is why. The account leaves it as keeping.

name.en: Fidelity to the generative process, which intelligence cannot oppose

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 99, 102-104; What openness is for

sense.en: Later drafts: the foundation is not a preference but fidelity to the process reality displays, 'not one value among others' but the condition of all valuing; its constraints cannot be opposed by intelligence as intelligence. Ren in October 2026 affirms the process outright. The README itself flags the drafts' move as reopening the is-ought crack.

entries.quote: It is fidelity to the generative process reality already displays.

reading.en: The account refuses this form. It does not assume becoming is good. Supplied as a free predicate, significance is fixed by no statement about the dynamics, by construction of the representation; that shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. A perspectivist denies the condition consistently, nothing reading no order entails C, and a warrant binding every possible mind stays open: neither claimed nor disproved. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics and entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation: non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

Open: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind. Such a warrant, where it would ground the condition, comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of what the non-entailment covers, with a witness of a consistent denial (bounded_rival).

source_adds.en: That opposing the process is self-defeating for intelligence as such; that the process is to be affirmed.

name.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a source of values

source.locator: Claim 97; The strongest objections, Covert totalization

sense.en: What we owe each other does not fall out of being joined: a parasite is coupled to its host too. Interdependence is demoted to a lens for accuracy; values are owned as chosen, though the seeing makes the choosing legible.

entries.quote: a parasite is coupled to its host too

reading.en: The negative half has checked and argued forms. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics; the clearer meets every requirement derived from wanting its own continuation and still ends the dweller; seeing is not valuing and coupling is not compliance. The account does not call its premises (the continuation condition for scope, C for order) chosen: it leaves them unasserted, warrant open. This is the folder's own self-correction, kept against its later fidelity drafts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on; the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics, though along every formed relation it would be.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

account_adds.en: A conditional path from one's own continuation past oneself, P1-P4 of 07 §4.6, with its crux open.

source_adds.en: That the premises are chosen, as an owned act; that seeing makes the choosing legible.

name.en: The questioner already standing on the bridge

source.locator: The argument, Why openness (善恶之本); claim 24

sense.en: Whoever asks what they ought to do has presupposed their own existence, which depends on the process continuing, and so has tacitly joined the business of keeping open. The README rates this the strongest answer to is-ought: it neither derives an ought from a fact nor concedes.

entries.quote: 任何提出「我应当做什么」之问者，其问之提出本身已预设此问者真实存在

reading.en: The first half is the account's starting point: a self acting for its own continuation presupposes that some continuation has significance, and T8 starts there, not from a wish. The condition (scope) is that presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint, which locates the contested step and answers nothing. Order takes more. Self-concern, itself a hypothesis, ranks ending what one depends on below, with no C; with the condition held de se it gives what C (order) asks only between listed level paths, one way. The account says this does not derive C; keeping open follows from neither premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): along any relation, the condition is exactly the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint; logically A iff P and (P implies A), given A implies P, which locates the contested step and derives nothing beyond it.

Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; wanting an end gives reason for what it requires only by a disclosed premise.

T8: this stance starts from what acting presupposes, held de se (§4.6, P1); P1 is not a third premise, being the self's presupposition, which the condition contains. Neither P1 nor the wish gives that the wider course is better: that is C's.

Theorem (any type; World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment): every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order ranks it higher.

Theorem and Conditional (self-concern and the condition as hypotheses): where the condition held de se holds, admission is decided and the two courses are level paths whose admissions are listed, so both admit nothing from some step on, a self-concerned order ranks every extension between them, as C asks there. One way. It does not derive C; self-concern and the condition both remain hypotheses.

This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it. Route 'what lies downstream': self-concern, with §4.6's P2 and P4, which rank nothing; it stops where one's line ends with its last stage still conditioning and at what lies beyond the listing. With every listed item marked, self-concern and C are one premise in two forms, and no reason for either.

account_adds.en: A conditional path past the self without the step (P1-P4 of 07 §4.6), and where it stops; P2 and P4 are open. The exact places where self-concern gives what C asks, and that with every listed item marked they are one premise in two forms.

source_adds.en: That the presupposition answers the fact-value gap and commits the asker to keeping open. The account claims neither: what asking presupposes is not self-concern, and what self-concern ranks stops short of 开.

name.en: Keeping open is not maximizing openness

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 2-3, 13, 15

sense.en: Keeping possibility open forbids collapsing it and forbids optimizing it. Any named quantity driven up is an axis, so 'as open as possible' is the race in gentler dress. 开 is a state of a process: 'more open here' is a pointing, not a measurement, and differs in logical form.

entries.quote: we should keep possibility open - which means not collapse, but not optimizing it

reading.en: The account makes the same refusal by a different route. Widening is a strict partial order, the unanimity of positive weightings, not a score: a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent where a comparison is mixed. But it remains a comparison of what courses admit and says which admits more. The source's 开 is no comparison at all. [AI reading]

says.en: So the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. (Any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission.)
Widening is one-way and transitive and says which admits more, not which is better.

Theorem (World; witnesses): along a course keeping widening by name, what every supported formation requires fixed within a finite family of conditions, the family's stock passes every bound and rises at arbitrarily late steps.

account_adds.en: A theorem that widening is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher (Sen's intersection approach, Pareto dominance). That keeping widening itself, in a finite family, drives a stock past every bound: on those premises the source's worry about a race gets a law [AI reading].

source_adds.en: 开 as a non-comparative state with a verdict. The account has one-course predicates (keeping every possibility, keeping widening on a course's moments, 全生成, 02's openness), and they carry no verdict: its verdicts of better compare two courses.

name.en: What matters is that the generating goes on

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claims 26, 95

sense.en: The one thing held is that at every place and time something stays unsettled and still able to be generated. 生生 is not complexity increase; it may be simplification or letting go. 生生 is 开 still there. The process can stop by freezing or by burning out, and neither is continuation.

entries.quote: 生生 = 开仍在

reading.en: The source holds this flat. The account's nearest statement, T8, is argued, for life, under two unasserted premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, with no verdict binding every possible mind. That one course keeps generating, rather than being merely wide now, is its open second-order direction. A finite balanced world has no course keeping widening by name. The nearest comparison is eventual widening: a course admitting at arbitrarily late steps eventually widens one admitting nothing from some step on; it tells going on from ending, not generating from keeping, and calls neither better. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the way is 生生, life in the whole and its continuing generation [AI reading, D1], compared by widening what can form, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.

Under two premises keeping widening from a moment is 全生成 at (nothing lost, the same possible). Reading [AI reading, D45]: 生生 read as widening is generation of the possible that loses none of it. Calling widening better is still C's, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
Open: the second-order direction of 生生, a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale.

Theorem (World; witnesses): a finite balanced world under the first law has no course keeping widening by name; under the first law the rest gives a finite family net at arbitrarily late steps, or it is not closed. Near-definitional or restating thermodynamics; none compares two courses.
生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]; neither the grammar's renewal without end, nor 02's generation (生成), which allows loss, nor any new organization.

Theorem (World; witnesses): one level path eventually widens another where, from some step on, it widens it on every tail: first-order widening read on late tails, not a comparison of growth, ignoring every finite stretch. It is not the second-order direction of 生生: a steady course eventually widens one that collapses, and it is silent on a lag.
Theorem (balance and dissipation): where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps.

account_adds.en: Throughput as a condition of keeping widening; generation (02) allows loss and is not 生生, and can go on at two orders of grain while what can form only returns. 02's openness, exchange beyond an enclosure, is the same word with another reference than 开.

source_adds.en: The line held flat and universal, at every place and time, as the one thing that matters. The folder itself compares no ranges; read as going on outranking present range, the account leaves that open and, where a lag decides it, a further premise.

name.en: An open loop, not any state or rule chosen once

source.locator: Claims 7, 22 (元闭); Genealogy, 2026-03-14

sense.en: The ask is not a particular state or one's reality made everyone's, but a loop kept open. The deepest closure, 元闭, freezes not one gap but the rule that makes new openings possible.

entries.quote: I think it is important to keep a open loop

reading.en: The form is in the account: where every step from some step on is a move of a fixed process, the possible under it does not keep widening; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end, which does not suffice. Openness as a property of how rules keep changing is an AI reading, D45. 06 reads 元闭 as a rule holding its result, one structure with stability. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

元闭 maps to a rule holding its result, perturbing only the state being drawn back. Reading [AI reading, D49]: stability and 元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from either side; the judgment differs and the structure does not.

account_adds.en: That a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible; that endless change of the part is not sufficient.

source_adds.en: The value stance that an open loop is what is to be kept, 'aligned with the incentive of any of us'. The account's law carries no such verdict.

name.en: 未, 可, 应, 转 as four independent marks

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14

sense.en: 开 has four aspects and all must hold: a not-yet region remains, generation is still possible, the process can respond, it can correct or return. The README calls this the Chinese texts' most useful addition: a world can be rich in options and closed if nothing responds or no route back exists.

entries.quote: a test with four independent failure modes

reading.en: 06 maps each mark to a spine structure and reports the reverse of independence, its own reading of the early claim. 转 read as returning gives 可 with no premise: on finite configurations a run starts exactly where a course reaches a return. 未 needs a world no list holds. One half survives: how much can be had does not fix return. The account's 开放 is only 未. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D49]: this mapping gives a result contrary to the early texts: they treat the four marks as independent; on the spine they are not. 转 read as returning gives 可, with no premise.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: the corpus's 开 is the four marks together; this theory's 开放 is only 未.

Theorem (any process): within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection (Onward.run_iff_returning).
Theorem (any process): keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (Transit.keeps_not_returns, three configurations).
As 06 maps 应: an exchange responds to a level; coupling bounds the response and does not fix it.

Theorem: with the process determined and two different configurations, a run whose configurations never return fixes, at each configuration it passes, no move other than the one it takes, whatever is read.

account_adds.en: That 06 §十 also sorts the nine lines' 归 and 不归 into three cases on the spine, and that 未 fails on any finite configuration. Why 转 matters to knowing: a run that never returns tests nothing it did not do.

source_adds.en: 应 as a failure mode of its own, a world in which nothing done changes anything, as a test of worlds. 06 gives response a law, not a mark that must hold.

name.en: Complexity and scale are not the measure of open and closed

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 16, 26

sense.en: A single act of tea can be extremely open and a vast totalitarian system extremely closed. Cosmic generation does not entail rising complexity, and rising complexity does not entail good. Ren demolished his own earlier complexity programme on this ground.

entries.quote: 繁简非开闭之标

reading.en: The account refuses the same measure: 生生 is not novelty or scale, and which formations count does not go by rank rising with complexity. But a course admitting all a smaller one admits and more does widen it, and C (order, the continuation condition fixing scope, neither asserted) then ranks it higher, so scale that comes as inclusion is not excluded. Tea against a vast state has no verdict: mixed, or unranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, not novelty or scale; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them. Answered; the order left open.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: Generation at two grains can go on while what can form only returns, so generation is no sign of range.

source_adds.en: That a small thing can be more open than a vast one. The account has no comparison that says so.

name.en: Good as protecting the open, evil as producing closure

source.locator: Claims 17, 23, 102-103; own words 27, 69

sense.en: 开/闭 is the fundamental pair and 善/恶 its ethical face. The criterion's form is scale-free, its content always situational. In English: what keeps the field alive is good, what closes it bad, what knowingly turns it into capture evil.

entries.quote: 生生不息者，开而不闭也；善者，护开也；恶者，成闭也

reading.en: 06 §十 names this and removes it: the early texts wrote evaluation into definitions, the account maps only structure. Closing in its form is no loss, a returning configuration being itself an absorbing region. Whether a closing supports or damages 生生 is for comparison: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, further commitments where mixed, neither asserted. The account says why: stability and 元闭 share one structure, so evaluation enters only through comparison. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism [AI reading, D49]: whether a closing supports, enriches or damages 生生 is said by comparison, not by type: the continuation condition fixes scope, C the order of widening and narrowing, what gains and loses needs a further commitment, neither premise asserted.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.
Reading [AI reading]: of the meta-attractor's closed loop, none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: The reason a verdict cannot sit in a type: one structure, two readings.

source_adds.en: Good and evil as real words at every scale; the scale-free form with situational content (claim 23), which the README calls its cleanest answer to 'whose values?'; 'evil' for the knowing conversion into capture. The live account keeps that structure apart as informed harm, a hard rival, and gives it no such name.

name.en: Two senses of closure: 成闭 and 护闭

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 18, 223

sense.en: 成闭 closes and never reopens; it is the thing called bad. 护闭 closes one place for a time to protect a larger opening: refusing invasion, quarantine, excising a spreading cancer, stopping a runaway. It is a form of 中. The README adds, as its own reading, a test: a defence that cannot say what would make it stand down has become 成闭.

entries.quote: 闭有二义：一曰成闭，闭而不复开；一曰护闭，暂闭一处以护更大之开

reading.en: The spine gives structures and no verdict. 成闭 is the lock: what is drawn in does not come back. 护闭 is removing at a branch the step that makes a configuration unobtainable (AI reading, D52); limits constraining steps leave what they constrain obtainable, so only 'larger opening' goes unmodelled. Ending a cancer is read as mixed, ranked only by reading or J1/J2. Under the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, a pure closing argued good would meet T8's refuter; a net weighting ranks it above only where the item weighs below zero. [AI reading]

says.en: 护闭: removing at a fork the step making a configuration unobtainable [AI reading, D52]. Limits that promise, train or stop harm constrain some steps while what they constrain can still be had, 护闭's structure; those monopolizing entry or removing alternatives are 成闭. Which kind depends on what it does to the obtainable, not its name.

targets.part: the 护闭, 成闭 and 限 rows; D52

says.en: Theorem (any process): where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture; keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s and removes exactly the losing steps.

Theorem (any type): for every determined law a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure. No ending is licensed.

Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading.

Theorem (any type): where a ranking puts a narrowing above its widening by one item, either it does not rank the pair as its own order ranks the kept sets (a misread or a framing) or the item weighs at zero or below; read right, exactly where it weighs below zero, and at zero it ties.

account_adds.en: The juncture is found by search only where configurations are listed and steps decided; finding every loss's juncture of every process gives LPO.

source_adds.en: Closure justified by service to a larger opening; 'bad' for 成闭; the stand-down test and the answer it offers to the enforcement antinomy. The capacity not to be beaten as 护闭, distinct from winning (claim 223, the assistant's distinction).

name.en: 伪开, the pseudo-open

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 20-21

sense.en: Outwardly open, inwardly closing: spending a momentary 可 to rob a long-term 未, a local opening closing the global one. Instances: technological monopoly, addiction systems, extreme ideology, Moloch competition, surface plurality. Detecting it is the core discipline. Formally 似开 joined to 实闭, closure that survives audit.

entries.quote: 伪开者，外显为开，内成其闭；以一时之可，夺长远之未；以局部之开，闭全境之开。

reading.en: 06 gives three spine structures and drops the charge of deceit. Local open, whole closed: takers each within what is given can together exceed it and end the renewal. Short open, long closed: a reading fixed by finite steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one, and distance to a break does not couple in by threshold. Surface open, meta closed: 元闭 seen from the state's side. Each law holds on its model. 06's rows read the early texts' own word, so the mapping comes by descent; the laws stand apart from it. [AI reading]

says.en: 伪开 one, two and three are mapped to joint excess, finite-stretch and threshold laws, and 元闭 from the state's side. The early definition's evaluation, 伪开 as deceit, is not mapped.
Takers each within what a renewal gives can together exceed it; proved on models, restating the commons (as ONE-PAGE states it).
A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (the renewable process; likewise the support-gated law with feedback).

Theorem (World): where a stock coupled by threshold only is the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

account_adds.en: Why the long form escapes detection: no finite record certifies renewal.

source_adds.en: The auditable definition 似开 joined to 实闭, the instances, and detection as a discipline; that it is modern closure's commonest disguise.

name.en: The compounding axis: winning buys more power to win

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claims 34-39, 41, 56

sense.en: On a rivalrous axis where winning buys capacity to win, leads compound and the axis selects whoever pushes hardest; no villain is needed. It runs away only where returns increase; where they diminish or rivals balance it self-limits. The pattern is form-agnostic: market, state, commons or AI can each become the closing thing.

entries.quote: a winner of the game should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game

reading.en: The form is checked. A rule read from the share it selects locks, 'that actual rules read the share' standing as the premise, as increasing returns stands as the source's condition. Shaping the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. Ranked by position, among two drawers or more a best response keeps nothing: 'trade everything for winning'. Form-agnostic: the lock belongs to how the rule reads. Two-kind counts, no noise; singly drawn locks are left by drift, those in counts that only grow can survive noise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c is at most s, whatever comes to every member alike.

Theorem (World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws): a chooser reading what couples in, its rule read from the count of its choices. The lock is read as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989).

Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (Arthur, Ermoliev and Kaniovski 1987; Arthur 1989; cited, not stated).

Theorem (any law of what stands next, natural amounts): drawers in turn, each ranking what it leaves by its position over the steps that remain: among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. Not that every race draws everything: where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass the course locks the other way with no capture by shapers; an exact lever at a step; selected control is not thereby capture.

source_adds.en: That actual axes (capital, attention, weapons, state power) meet the premise and run identically; selection for recklessness. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with no field test. The list of what rivalrous selection favours (claim 41).

name.en: Every maximizing structure is a hidden extreme; every extreme closes

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts and 闭有二义; claims 19, 40, 46, 105

sense.en: A strong drive on any axis fixates and blinds to all outside it. 极皆成闭: every extreme (concentration, dispersion, control, release, love, goodness) leaves the process unable to turn; 反者道之动 stated as structure. An earlier file adds that which case applies, reversal or runaway, must be checked.

entries.quote: 任何「最大化」之结构，皆为一种隐性之极

reading.en: The account gives where this holds and corrects the universal form. With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. Without room keeping can be an optimum, and with a coupling for each step a need stays met, every optimum keeps it at every horizon. So maximizing is not closing as such. 反者道之动 has only a narrow live neighbour: 06 reads 物壮则老 as a line not returning to its places, on a bounded room, 反 read as 返. The source's 反 is an extreme turning into its opposite, which that does not state. T3 on trained systems is conjectured. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with room, every optimum of a rising order stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. A known theorem restated, per ONE-PAGE.
Where r is at most q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon. One optimizer's law.
At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general) a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity, so restraint is no mutual best response.

G03, 物壮则老: where a line's places do not return and a list holds them, the line's steps are fewer than the list and the line from x is not unending. New; a bounded room is added; not unending does not show one end.

Known weaknesses: the law adds a bounded room; 早已 is read as not unending, showing no end. Reading 壯 and 不道 as a line not returning, and 反 as 返 by chapter 40's 反者道之動, is a cross-chapter reading; Wang Bi's note is left unfollowed and recorded.

account_adds.en: The hypothesis (room) that decides, and a witnessed case where optimizing keeps.

source_adds.en: The universal claim about all extremes, love and goodness included, and reversal at the limit. The live 物壮则老 law is of not returning on a bounded room, not of an extreme turning.

name.en: Correlation, not irreversibility, is what kills a whole

source.locator: The argument, The reframe that does the most work; claims 47, 49, 109, 139-140, 230

sense.en: Ren's load-bearing correction: what kills a whole is not that parts die but that they stop dying independently. One logic, metric or dependency lets one shock take all. Variety is 'enough, not most', protecting only against shocks parts meet independently; a quiet shared dependency is latent correlation.

entries.quote: What we need is to have a varieties of systems so they don't all collapse

reading.en: It has live laws under other words. One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them; groups depending on a coupled family end together, a patch read alone showing no excess (a quiet shared dependence), so ending selects only between families. Two reviewers moved under one cause fail while every name is kept, and a cause in every formula and no bound fails all (latent correlation). Witnesses that only copy others add no certificate, one narrow form of 'enough, not most'. World or pure-core models; which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis. A search on the source's words misses these. [AI reading]

says.en: One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

Theorem (World): a patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess read alone and both end read as one. Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Why a condition runs into excess, which conditions are coupled, and mixing between groups are hypotheses or not stated.

Theorem (pure core; failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied): moving two of three reviewers under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept; a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer. It does not show the formulas are the actual causes of failure.

Theorem (any type, no axiom; finite roster): where each witness added copies one already on it, in its reports, its support and every fault set it is inside, inspection takes the same steps and gives the same certificate at every pool of faults. That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition for correction by several reviewers; that more groups on one family of conditions are no more safety, as this entry reads 'ending selects only between families'.

source_adds.en: Correlated collapse as what closes a civilization; shock-relative sufficiency ('enough, not most'); plurality as survival architecture. Populations of systems under novel shocks are not modelled. A common-event error formula stands only in theories/becoming/history/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md, not live, which says no actual rate has been measured.

name.en: Lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion; the substrate drawn past renewal

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; claims 50-51, 55, 109

sense.en: Collapse takes three shapes. The portable seven-feature form adds: the boundary drawn too narrowly, substrate consumed faster than it renews, success raising the power to succeed, tight coupling, action outrunning understanding, the model becoming the world, correction disabled. Keep the substrate replenished faster than it is drawn down.

entries.quote: Collapse takes three shapes: lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion.

reading.en: Each shape has a law form, on models. Exhaustion: steps of joint excess from a low enough level end the renewal and what depends on it; a regime's point of no return is exact. Lock-in: the capture laws. Monoculture: groups on one coupled family end together; that is not monoculture of value. The list as one pattern is not stated. T1, that persistence certifies the joint draw, is conjectured: passed in two simulations and on yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on it at a need of at least m.
The point of no return is exact (RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below), for one condition under a positive standing draw, in whole numbers (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §3 states it).
Thesis T1, persistence certifies the joint draw; on ONE-PAGE: conjectured, passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings.
Theorem (World): groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them. Which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis.

account_adds.en: Rises at the point of no return superadditive up to one unit, so joint draws cannot be judged one by one.

source_adds.en: Monoculture of logic and value as a shape; the seven features as one recurring pattern across forms; that actual civilizations show it. Collapse-and-regress as a fourth pattern, with Ren's remark that 'totalizing attractors vs others' is itself too reductive (claim 51).

name.en: A model smaller than its system, and power collapsing reality toward it

source.locator: Claims 45-46, 100

sense.en: The root error is a model smaller than its system: the self, value or causal web drawn too small. Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it: optimize one thin proxy with enough force and the many-dimensioned world is crushed to that dimension. Every boundary is a working cut, false when it hides dependence.

entries.quote: Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it

reading.en: Three checked forms. A selection reaches exactly what couples into its selector, stated as the proxy problem. With room, an optimum drains what lies beyond. A region's comparison takes the region as input: the smaller it is the more lies beyond, and going on is no sign nothing is lost. Each is on its model, the first near-definitional, its force the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. 03 reads it as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975).

Theorem (World): the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. In Clearing the clearer closes the dweller beyond it: going on is no sign that nothing is lost.

With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does (ONE-PAGE). Proved; a known theorem restated. T3 on trained systems conjectured, partly supported.

account_adds.en: A premise-free statement of what any selection through given couplings can tell apart.

source_adds.en: 'Root error' as the unifying diagnosis; false cuts producing bad action; collapse of reality toward the model as such, beyond the drained condition.

name.en: Cancer as defection from a truce, killing the host and dying with it

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claim 43

sense.en: Used as mechanism, not ornament: multicellularity is a truce and cancer defects from it, locally rational, globally suicidal, killing the host and dying with it. 'Cosmic cancer' is that dynamic at planetary scale, and the frame implies an immune system (claim 152).

entries.quote: locally rational, globally suicidal

reading.en: The biology has a checked form: a lineage selection within raises, confined to depending on the whole, has no member after the end; one depending on a condition outside goes on. So 'dying with it' needs confinement. No verdict by type: under the condition (scope) a tumour's continuation counts. Under C (order), whole-run and possibility readings rank the overdrawer's absence, the stepwise does not, and event by event a C comparison prefers the overdraw; J1/J2 ranks it, the tiers a reading. No reading is chosen. The planetary step is not taken. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to; in the witness Body the unconfined lineage still has a member. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.
Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure.
Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened; a tumour does not tell the scopes apart, a hurricane only on a stronger reading of wanting.

Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks the absence of the overdrawer above its occurrence under the whole-run and possibility readings, not under the stepwise. No reading is chosen.

Conditional (C; World): read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw.

Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings. The tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a rival is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: The confinement clause, without which a rise outlives its whole; sequestration as what founding carries.

source_adds.en: Cancer as a civilizational diagnosis, and the immune-system implication. Both stand only in this folder and its sources.

name.en: Death of parts is a feature; decay is a form of growth

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; What openness is for; claims 47-48, 221

sense.en: Many irreversible changes are good; ecosystems endure through vast local deaths; mutation and death keep a living space alive. Keeping open does not mean preserving every form. What closes is a structure taking part of itself as permanent and enforcing that.

entries.quote: death is not a bug but a feature

reading.en: The account has the mechanism and refuses the verdict. Generation goes on through carrying renewal, and with brief parts a whole persists only as parts arise. Closing in its form is no loss. But 'feature' is no dynamic's word here: with the continuation condition for scope every narrowing loses something with significance, and only C or further premises order anything. Apoptosis is read as mixed; no ending is licensed. Ending is one response under J1-J4, with residual losses. [AI reading]

says.en: At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch), as ONE-PAGE states it. Theorems for every relation and class.
Theorem (World): a whole arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active, where parts are brief no d steps pass without one arising.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance; read as losing and opening something, such endings are mixed [AI reading, D65]. No ending is licensed: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it.
Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E): among four responses, end: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses.

account_adds.en: The two grains separate what ends from what goes on.

source_adds.en: That decay is growth, and the closer as a structure taking itself as permanent. The affirmation behind both is what the account declines.

name.en: Model lag: acting faster than a model can be kept true

source.locator: The argument, Model lag; claims 52-54

sense.en: Where capability and interdependence grow exponentially while minds and institutions update linearly or worse, models go false faster than they are repaired; to keep accelerating is a system outrunning its senses. It describes the present, not a law: the speed is adjustable.

entries.quote: the speed of the governing organizations' understanding reality only grows in a sub-linear speed

reading.en: The account has exact laws of lag: a rule reading late keeps no band narrower than a bound set by its lag and the rest's motion, and a slow rule needs a long enough stretch to fix fast courses. A reading adds that a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads. Nothing says how fast actual complexity or institutions grow. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; rules over whole numbers): a rule reading l steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(l + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L is at least 2N - 1.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads.

sense.en: The keystone moves from 'prevent concentration' to preserving correction: catastrophe is where a harmful process's time-constant drops below the correction loop's, an actor able to disable correction itself. Exit, voice and undo stay faster than the harm.

reading.en: Forms exist. A reader keeps a condition within its margin exactly where it reads it often enough for margin, draw and lag: 'faster than the harm' for one condition, on the World. source.locator: The argument, Belief is part of the material; claims 63-70, 229

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Where what a course ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below from every standpoint, with no C. Where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order reverses, and the clearer goes on supported while the dweller ends. So the incentive is shared only where continuations are coupled; likewise position protects no greatest part that depends on what the race draws down. Self-concern is a premise, weaker than C. Where what an expansion ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below from every standpoint.
The clearer meets every requirement derived from wanting its own continuation and still ends the dweller.

Position does not protect: from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive. In the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

name.en: Many independent measures of worth

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 40, 114, 119

sense.en: No metric, price included, carries all the variety of worth. A single scoreboard is monoculture at the level of value, and the compounding axis collapses many measures onto the one that wins.

entries.quote: A dashboard that crowns one measure as final, even a humane measure, is still a path toward closure.

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. C (order, the continuation condition fixing scope, neither asserted, warrant open) crowns no measure: it is what every positive weighting shares, and mixed comparisons go both ways, one weight for each item being one choice that ranks by number. A measure for mixed parts stays open. A metric closes where it is read from what it selects: it then outlives a loss it does not read; T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with one trained system's lock formed and its bridge failed. Plural weightings are not plural institutions. [AI reading]

says.en: One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; one weight for every item ranks by number.
T7, a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation: the lock proved for any type, actual metrics conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed and the bridge failed; no field test.

account_adds.en: Why a lock survives its own refutation (lock_outlives_loss).

source_adds.en: That independent measures must be kept alive as a requirement; that price in particular cannot carry them (the Coasean claim 119 has no live counterpart).

name.en: Every structure is a means; judge the dynamic, not the label

source.locator: Claims 56, 136-137, 144; own words 46

sense.en: Central, distributed, strong, soft, market, commons, state, AI: none is good by label. Some systems may keep strong guardians and others lighter ways. The invariant is functional: no single point may capture and totalize the whole; exit and voice survive. Power is not bad as such, and reflexive decentralization can sabotage coordination.

entries.quote: The issue is not the label. The issue is the dynamic under pressure.

reading.en: The account makes the same move in structure, without the invariant. Which kind a limit is goes by what it does to what can be had, not its name; a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours; selected control is not thereby capture, and the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. 'Centraliz' has no hit in the chapters and one in the records, control theory's decentralized control: the question of forms is not taken up. 06's row comes by descent, reading the early texts' own 限. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name; a limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains steps while what it constrains can still be had: 护闭's structure.

targets.part: the 成生之限／绝生之限 row

says.en: Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: That the capture laws hold whichever share the rule favours.

source_adds.en: The functional invariant on any structure; plural guardians within one world; the warning about reflexive decentralization.

name.en: Cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing

source.locator: Claims 56-57; strongest objections, Cooperation is not automatically good

sense.en: Ren's own objection: cooperation is not automatically good, so the question is what possibilities an action creates. The README says the corpus answers this only by the Test, and thinly.

entries.quote: cooperative on the wrong thing could be why worse than just competing on it

reading.en: 05 states that no law says cooperation is good. It also has a mechanism the folder lacks, reading pooling as cooperation being a reader's join. A group's closure is the union of its members', and an act differing only beyond that union is selected alike by every group within it: a perfectly pooled group is blind where its members are. The one-page case is this: the community's largest steady catch ends the mussel bed it was told nothing of. The laws do not say that loss counts; that is the condition's (scope), and order C's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance for the gap): a group's closure is the union of its members' closures; in two balanced flows, an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's own joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it at every step.

In a frozen test, three AI fishers (language models told what to do, not trained systems) told nothing of the bed kept it in no season: a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts [AI reading].

Any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. That is asked under the two premises of 07, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.

account_adds.en: Why cooperation has this limit: the reach of its pooled coupling, with an exact statement.

source_adds.en: That it can be worse than competing. The account compares no such pair.

name.en: Sensing held in common as far as function requires

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 133-134, 154

sense.en: A harm must be sensed faster than it spreads, which needs sensing distributed rather than held at one vantage: for function before fairness. 'Shared' may be federated or forkable; the invariant is anti-capture. The line between shared sensing and arbitration is never drawn.

entries.quote: the way a living body senses and answers without needing a king

reading.en: The functional half has laws. A pool separates exactly what some member separates, so what a harm's sensing needs can be read as who is in the pool; a reading requires the drawn level to couple in by level, before the point of no return. It has edges: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would. Institutions are not modelled; pools' forming and resisting capture is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World), as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 lists it under pool couplings: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates (World). Edge: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would, unless a reader is admitted from outside (witness).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling (by level and not by threshold, into a selecting pool), and time (before the regime's point of no return).
Does not show how pools form, last and resist capture.

account_adds.en: The exact reach of a pool and the recruitment edge.

source_adds.en: Distribution as a requirement; federation and forking as forms; who arbitrates.

name.en: Competition is not the deep law; zero-sum above a threshold is suicidal

sense.en: Major transitions, symbiogenesis, mutual aid, multilevel selection and commons show cooperation at least as deep. Above a power threshold zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal. Evolving toward struggle is selected out when the 境 changes, because struggle is not 生. Not fighting is possible.

entries.quote: Competition is not the deep law of nature

reading.en: The account keeps both sides as theorems. Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum, not rivalry: positions' rises total their falls. Position does not protect: where a race produces joint excess, a premise, every greatest part depending on that condition ends, one not so depending continues. So the threshold claim becomes a hypothesis. Selection among groups and Hamilton's rule restate known forms of cooperation's selection, with no ranking of depth. Selection against struggle has no live law; no dynamic is good here. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

Theorem (any type for the counting): no change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall. Position does not protect: from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive; in the clearing witness one not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.
Theorem (any type): selection within groups and among them at equal sizes, the multilevel form of Price's equation. 04 says its laws restate known results.
Theorem (any type): selection with returns to groupmates, Hamilton's rule, for groups of equal size founded mixed with offspring numbers additive in own and groupmates' amounts.

account_adds.en: Real conflict as a theorem the folder's hopeful register plays down.

source_adds.en: Cooperation as at least as deep as competition; symbiogenesis, mutual aid and major transitions as its evidence (no hit for symbio or Kropotkin in the live files; major transitions appear only as not shown, in the confined-rise record; multilevel selection is present as a law); 斗 as selected out; the power threshold as a fact of actual worlds.

name.en: Change the game rather than win it: final victory is still closure

source.locator: Claims 95, 118; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: Winning the runaway and building a power large enough to end it both terminate in lock-in. Ruin and final victory are different doors into the same dead room; the enemy is not strength or order but foreclosure by whatever road. So change the payoffs, not the winner.

entries.quote: A final victory is still closure.

reading.en: Half has a form: a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not whom it favours, and where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps. 'One dead room' is scoped: full taking alongside another taker ends what depends on it, the full taker included. Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, so a kept victory is not ruin; position fails only where the winner depends on what it draws down. No verdict by type: under C for order, with the condition for scope, neither asserted, sharing ranks above winning by consumption in that family on every reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings. No reading is chosen.

Position does not protect: every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m ends; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise.
Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration.
The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: structure: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need): full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included.

account_adds.en: That a lock is a structure and carries no verdict; a critical mass can lock either way; a winner not depending on what it draws down continues.

source_adds.en: That final victory and ruin are one outcome; final victory as closure whatever its road, where the account ranks victory by consumption below sharing only under C in that family; foreclosure as the one enemy.

name.en: Channel the drives; hierarchy and status are not the enemy

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 115-117

sense.en: Status and hierarchy are older than our species. Suppressed they re-route; with payoffs changed and drives unshaped, the race rebuilds inside the garden. Some hierarchies brought peace. Drives are tools: the more understood, the more possibility space can be constructed.

entries.quote: A hunger for status can raise a hospital or burn a village.

reading.en: The account's live hits for 'hierarch' are a formal hierarchy of families and FEP's hierarchical models, not social hierarchy. No law of status or of channelling drives was found; a Reading that positional goods stay zero-sum is a neighbour and channels nothing. drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind is the fuller home of the source's claim, read separately. Not a defect by itself. [AI reading]

name.en: The human substrate; care as the floor; mortality the one closure

source.locator: Claim 143; strongest objections, A system, not a civilization

sense.en: A society is sustained by childhood, illness, aging, friendship, grief, ritual, love and death, not incentives alone. Care is the floor that makes freedom real for those who cannot leave. Mortality is the one closure no arrangement escapes. How a civilization gives up the thrill of winning is owned as missing.

entries.quote: care is the floor that makes freedom real for those for whom walking away was never on offer

reading.en: The account does not take this up. It has formations, not childhood or grief; it says no test has human participants and that well-being beyond admitted continuation is not shown. Its nearest is conditional practical judgment on a common support, which is not this claim. So the objection 'a system, not a civilization' stands against the account too, as this entry reads it. [AI reading]
