name.en: 模有高下 and 感须校正: guards against relativism and private intuition

source.locator: Claims 32-33, 106

sense.en: Models are all situational but not equal: their ranking lies in whether they better reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪, protect 开 and guide action in this 境. Feeling must be corrected by the echo of the situation, others' response, consequences and the mutual attestation of models. Every useful model is coarser than its system, this one included.

entries.quote: 模有高下

reading.en: The phrases have no live hit, the mechanisms do. Against relativism the account gives adequacy relative to a supplied requirement, not rank: a reading is too coarse or fine enough for what it answers to, and which requirement is right the law does not say. 感须校正 has a form and a limit: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model, so correction beyond it needs a risked act or a reading from outside. Ranking by protecting 开 would bring 开 in as standard. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading: the law says what a reading must carry for a requirement to be met by one response; which requirement is right it does not say. A reading too coarse for the requirement is the covering's failure; a finer reading keeps every common response.

Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; a model right along its course and wrong off it is never refuted there, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993). What tells such worlds apart comes from beyond its own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of correction by echo: it reaches what the course exposes.

source_adds.en: A ranking of models by whether they reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪 and protect 开; the mutual attestation of models. The README lists both guards as lost between the Chinese and English tracks.

name.en: One logic for humans, the living world and made minds

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 108, 135

sense.en: None is master, resource or tool by default. The threshold is whether a being bears states whose disregard would thin the web, not usefulness or intelligence. Where a made mind's status is uncertain, the uncertainty is a duty to inquire and limit abuse. 'Humanity' means the keeping-alive of the shared future.

entries.quote: there are logic and common sense that should be followed by all beings

reading.en: The continuation condition's scope is wider and unasserted: for anything, not beings past a threshold. C gives order. T8 says for life names whose way it is, not whose losses count, and it is the way of those whose line runs through life, of whatever substrate. Which formations count differs by relation discerned; whether an actual AI counts is not shown. The source's threshold, states whose disregard thins the web, sits nearer the centers' scope, a reading, than the condition. No duty under uncertainty is shown. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. Not asserted; significance neither graded nor necessarily positive.
T8, argued: for life says whose way it is, not whose losses count: every continuation's still does. It is the way of those whose own line runs through life, of whatever substrate.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center.

account_adds.en: The objection the scope draws: why 'anything', a tumour and a hurricane tested, sharpened and not resolved.

source_adds.en: A positive threshold; a duty of inquiry under uncertainty; 'one logic' as a common norm for all beings.

name.en: The determined adversary

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 146, 153

sense.en: One who understands all this, is neither deluded nor trapped, and races by preference: 'stop believing in the race' is no defence against him. Rated the biggest crack and owned as unsolved. Ren's design goal is recognition and situational correction, not elimination.

entries.quote: races because he prefers to win

reading.en: The account states the same gap as limits. Seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, a perspectivist denies the continuation condition (scope) consistently, nothing reading no order entails C (order), neither asserted, and the clearer meets every requirement derived from its own continuation. So no law moves one who prefers otherwise; 07 names informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, the hard rival. It adds no defence either; the two are alike here in leaving this unsolved. [AI reading]

says.en: Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.
bounded_rival gives a consistent denial of the condition; no verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That the denial is consistent, by witness, not merely that it is hard to answer.

source_adds.en: The practical problem of defence: recognition of destabilizing behaviour and coordinated stopping (claim 153). Not modelled.

name.en: The governance paradox: whatever can prevent capture can capture

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 147, 149-152; Who constrains the constrainers

sense.en: Any institution strong enough to coordinate can become the new closure, the project's own instruments included. Defence must be bounded, contestable and able to stand down; emergency powers are capture surfaces; no model guarantees stand-down. Stopping a superhuman defector seems to require the concentration forbidden.

entries.quote: any system strong enough to prevent capture can itself capture

reading.en: The account has the loop's form and marks the question open. A Reading has a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locking as the rule it replaced did, only a change of law leaving (the imperial examination, as read). Corruption of courts and audit is read as a loop reaching the routes of 明; term limits and audits as pooling. The models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. How pools resist capture is not shown. No law of standing down. The Reading's example is read in the meta-attractor line, a sibling of this folder, so that example comes by descent; the capture laws stand apart from it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where selection does not lower its carriers' share under a favouring rule and every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks from any start as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. It rests on the capture laws.

Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.
Does not show: the capture loop under noise beyond its one proved case; and how pools form, last and resist capture.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: Control selected and lock left in time are separable in three of four combinations; the fourth is not shown.

source_adds.en: The enforcement antinomy; stand-down, sunset and audit as requirements; who watches the watchers.

name.en: Trust before verification

source.locator: The argument, 2026-10-04, Trust before verification; claims 225-227

sense.en: From a monologue, quoted in translation, the glosses the assistant's: verification and transparency are useless without trust; trust rests on credible information; do not presume the other untrustworthy, begin with contact. Trust keeps verification from becoming surveillance. Steps must be conditional and observable.

entries.quote: 「无论你是建立核查机制（verification），还是提高透明度（transparency），只要没有信任，这些都白搭」

reading.en: The account has no statement of trust; this scope is proposed here, on its model of waiting. Restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. And mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source, which limits 'begin with contact'. Verification has a limit of its own: behaviour at an unread occasion can differ while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares its lump; intention and another's false belief are not stated. Tolerance is not shown good. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, not rebuild it where it is lost everywhere; mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source.

Reading: given a law the readings select, behaviour at an unread occasion can differ from that law's while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares the occasion's lump, and only there. Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.

account_adds.en: The need for a grounded start, a source before the loop.

source_adds.en: Trust itself; the order contact, trust, verification; trust as what bounds verification; step size against a decisive defector, which the README lists as missing.

name.en: Leaving the race without being eaten

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 160-166, 222-224

sense.en: The load-bearing open question. The destination is easy; assurance, living proofs, visible alternatives and protected correction carry people through; the transition must become materially safer than the race. A participant says it from inside: falling behind means being beaten. A late exit is the costliest.

entries.quote: It is leaving the race without being eaten during the leaving.

reading.en: The account has exits from a lock and when they close, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective. Late exit has a model form: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock. Where the rest outruns a renewal, only a change of its exchange helps. Conditional commitment has the tolerating law's form, with a limit: without one sparing all it waits on, total withholding stays. Tipping has a count form, no noise, not of leaving a race. Its verdict on guarantee is no. It has no assurance, living proofs or material safety. The join to leaving a race is a reader's. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits, each with law, model, hypotheses and edge: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, restraint within the joint slack, give first with a reserve, and others. Once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.
That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system is not shown.
Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (counts): at a threshold with lo < c < hi the course tips: from a start above the shapers' share rises strictly at every step; from a start below it falls strictly at every step. Without noise.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, several with the step at which its window closes.

source_adds.en: Safety while leaving, the question the folder calls load-bearing; assurance contracts, the seed abundance unit, living proofs, material safety, common-knowledge manufacture; tipping out of an actual race. The account's frozen tests are of laws, not of a transition.

name.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 5, 138

sense.en: Build to survive failure, not to prevent it: a body does not forbid illness, and demanding a guarantee is the control reflex by which the tyrant gets built. What stays open is the sample space, through plurality: if some systems fail, the whole can keep evolving.

entries.quote: I don't think there are ways to absolutely ensure any system not collapse

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION answers 'can we always?' with no guarantee, by named laws: selection reaches what couples in, a finite record does not certify renewal, points of no return are exact. Each is a theorem on its model and whether a collective meets its hypotheses is empirical. The source's remedy does not come with it. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. The theory's own laws, each on its stated model, show why: a selection reaches only what couples into it, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.
Together they rule out a guarantee from the theory, however much is observed; whether an actual collective meets their hypotheses is empirical.
Theorem (World): groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis.

account_adds.en: Which three senses of 'always' come apart, and the verdict on each.

source_adds.en: Plurality as sufficing for the whole to survive failure, which 'ending selects only between families' bears on and does not state; the claim about the control reflex.

name.en: A theory that publishes what would defeat it

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; Genealogy; What was lost, §29 falsifiers

sense.en: The chosen-premise version is the only one that publishes its own falsifiers; later drafts deleted them and their governing file forbade their return. The README counts this among the losses that violate the theory's own anti-lossy stance.

entries.quote: What would defeat this

reading.en: The practice lives on: each thesis states what it forbids and what refutes it, and the one page has a column for what would show each claim wrong. Its scope is sharper. Laws of the root forbid no relation; the dynamics cannot show the two premises (the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted) wrong; T8 falls only to a case argued. So the falsifiers bear on theses and on the derivation's premises, not on 'that it continue'. [AI reading]

says.en: A table column 'What would show it wrong'; the two premises: 'the dynamics cannot show them wrong'.
Thesis (philosophical, argued): as a language the explanatory reading forbids nothing; for a class named for a domain, stated cases; as an explanation, no observation.
T8. Forbids and refuted by: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests with recorded failures; a statement of what no observation can do.

name.en: The founding turn: the game's design, and many games

sense.en: Conflict escalates from identity tagging to wanting elimination; nobody in the fight sees that the fault is the game's design, not anyone's idea. Forbidding others to redesign their game is tyranny, including the right to choose badly.

name.en: Same theory, other language: 生生不息 as 开而不闭

source.locator: Relations, becoming; claims 10, 29

sense.en: The README's own relation to the becoming lineage: 'that it continue' is 生生不息 without the Chinese, and 生生不息者，开而不闭也 makes the identity explicit. This folder is the possibility-side frame from which 生生不息 is derived. Ren: the whole apparatus reduces to saying keep-the-possibility-space-open clearly.

entries.quote: same theory, other language

reading.en: 06 refuses the identity: same characters, different senses, not to be merged. The corpus's 生生不息 splits into 生, 生生 and 不息; its 开 is four marks and the theory's 开放 only 未; 善, 恶 and 智 have no predicate. The account's centre is that a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost. Its ethics rests on the continuation condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, and keeping open is derived from neither. So the apparatus does not reduce to it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: several words of the corpus share characters with this theory's and differ in sense, and may not be merged: its 生生不息 divides into 生, 生生 and 不息, the formal Web.Unceasing being far weaker; its 开 is the four marks, this theory's 开放 only 未; 善, 恶, 智 have no formal predicate.
A selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts [AI reading].

account_adds.en: The split of one word into several structures, and a centre in what a selection reaches, which keeping open does not name.

source_adds.en: That one account could be said wholly in 开, with 开闭 as a frame transforming into the others (claim 29). The README's relation is its own dated claim, not a live one.

name.en: We are ourselves selected by the attractor: can we escape?

source.locator: Claims 42, 62, 70; Open questions, Whether we can escape at all

sense.en: Competitive systems select for power, not wisdom, and select those who believe the race into the driver's seat. Humans are themselves selected and shaped by the attractor, which puts our own escape probability in question. Ren's open problem; the corpus gives no answer.

entries.quote: 如果我们人类本身即受到此attractor筛选和塑造

reading.en: The account has the form, with a window. The corpus's selecting the selectors, carried by descent since the Reading is of the corpus's own phrase, is read as the pool counted as the population is: where readers are drawn from the selected, a reading of what lies beyond the share turns the course only while its readers are not yet the fewer; later it leaves the lock. On counts, no noise; that readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading, and LA2's bridge failed for one trained judge. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors', the passage from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce the rule that selects you, is the pool counted as the population is. So 明 in time is a reading of what lies beyond the share made while its readers are not yet the fewer; the same reading made later leaves the lock in place. That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading.

Counts, no noise: a reading turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 states it).
Theorem (counts): at a threshold with lo < c < hi, from a start above the shapers' share rises strictly at every step; from a start below it falls strictly at every step.

account_adds.en: An exact deadline for 明 on counts, and that the same selection can lock either way from a critical mass.

source_adds.en: That actual humans are so selected; a probability of escape; the latent majority. The account states and tests none of these.

name.en: Life, plurality and a thin floor: the values named with teeth

source.locator: Claim 98

sense.en: The chosen values are life (that the living goes on), plurality (many worlds and kinds, free to differ, change and die) and a deliberately thin floor of freedom and dignity beneath every being, all inside the one line held without exception.

entries.quote: The chosen values are named with teeth

reading.en: T8's for life is nearest to the first: argued, with the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted; for life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. The floor's nearest form is J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent, and basic there means what a form of living needs to go on, not freedom or dignity. Plurality is no value here: ending selecting between families is a law with no verdict. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the way is 生生 [AI reading, D1], compared by widening what can form, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). For life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.

Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: J2 is defended by non-substitution, the basic layer being what a form of living needs to go on at all, at the cost of compensation across layers; a rival is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: The non-substitution argument for basic priority and its stated cost.

source_adds.en: Plurality as a named value; dignity and a floor of freedom beneath every being; values chosen and owned, with teeth.

name.en: Individual solutions to collective problems are part of the disease

source.locator: Claim 74

sense.en: A standing correction Ren applies to AI output: answering a collective problem with an individual's remedy is itself part of the problem.

entries.quote: Individual solutions to collective problems are themselves part of the disease

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Where the rest alone outruns the renewal, every dependent formation ends whatever a member takes, and no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. Where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack, a flow taking less by the excess keeps the need met. So an individual's restraint fails on one side of an exact line and is enough on the other, on the World model. 'Disease' is no dynamic's word here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World, with balance and a local gate): every formation depending at a need of at least m ends whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint.

Theorem (World: balance): a break where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack has every drawer taking less than all that is taken, and a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met.

account_adds.en: The exact line between the two cases, in the rest's draw against the renewal.

source_adds.en: The universal form; 'disease' as a verdict; that it is a discipline on how an AI answers.

name.en: Exit's failure mode: the most-joined option best by being most-joined

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 120

sense.en: Exit's stated failure: where network effects make the most-joined option best by being most-joined, the worth axis compounds and a dominant destination re-forms, leaving only the anti-closure constraint as backstop.

entries.quote: the worth axis itself compounds and a dominant destination re-forms

reading.en: Proposed here, not stated by the account: the form is a law. A chooser over two policies takes the first where its rule weighs it at least as much, that count rising by one; the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, even where the score favours the second. With noisy choices, counts that only grow lock with probability one where returns are strong enough (cited, not stated). That worlds to join are such policies is this entry's join: the account has no destinations. [AI reading]

says.en: A chooser over two policies takes the first where its rule weighs it at least as much as the second, that policy's count rising by one; the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy. Witness: three choices to one keep the first against a score weighing the second twice as much.

Counts that accumulate, with noisy choices an urn with increasing returns, lock with probability one where the returns are strong enough (Arthur, Ermoliev and Kaniovski 1987; Arthur 1989; cited, not stated); a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

account_adds.en: That the lock holds against a score favouring the other option, by witness.

source_adds.en: Members choosing among worlds; the constraint as backstop.

name.en: Each ideology is coherent inside its paradigm

source.locator: Claim 58; own words 1

sense.en: Reasoning inside a paradigm's vocabulary always concludes that society failed because it did not go far enough in that direction, which is why both sides of a conflict find themselves equally reasonable and equally aggrieved.

entries.quote: Every ideology arrives wrapped in a paradigm

reading.en: Proposed here, not stated of ideology: 'ideolog' and 'paradigm' have no hit in the chapters, and the join is this read's. Its form: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model, so it can be right along its course and wrong off it, never refuted there; where a reading is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed. The account also warns that 'closed' can shield a theory from counterexamples. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; a model right along its course and wrong off it is never refuted there. What tells such worlds apart comes from an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: A list of what 'closed' must be told apart from, substantive disagreement among them, which the source's 'equally aggrieved' does not ask.

source_adds.en: Ideology and paradigm as such; 'did not go far enough' as the recurring conclusion; both sides equally reasonable.
